content.text: The redline validated. Submitting the finding.

input.quote: 14. INSURANCE. Throughout the term of this Agreement, Contractor shall maintain workers compensation insurance in the amount required by statute, comprehensive general liability insurance with coverage of at least one million dollars ($1,000,000) and professional errors and omissions insurance for bodily injury, property damage or other losses with coverage of at least one million dollars ($1,000,000), in connection with the provision of Services by Contractor pursuant to the terms of this Agreement.
input.rationale: An insurance clause is present at Section 14 (p0048), so this is a partial-coverage deviation rather than a missing clause. It already satisfies two elements of the preferred position — workers' compensation as required by statute, and certificates of insurance on request with notice of material change. Three gaps remain: (i) CGL states only a $1,000,000 limit with no $2,000,000 aggregate; (ii) professional E&O is $1,000,000 against our preferred $2,000,000; and (iii) there is no cyber/privacy liability coverage at all. Cyber coverage is squarely warranted here: Section 1(c) (p0007) contemplates Contractor personnel working at Company facilities and accessing Company computer systems, and Section 8 (p0038) confirms Contractor obtains Company data, records and Confidential Information in performing the Services. A vendor with premises access and access to our data and systems with no cyber coverage sits at the playbook walk-away line. The document defines no "Customer Data" term, so the redline ties the cyber trigger to Company data and Confidential Information as defined in Section 8. We also added the one-year post-term tail and "at its own expense" from the model language, since E&O and cyber claims are typically made after the engagement ends. The edit is a single in-place amendment to the existing limits sentence, leaving the workers' compensation, certificate and notice provisions untouched. We did not challenge the "or self-insurance" language, which is a lower-value point at this severity. Fallback of E&O $1M (already met) plus cyber $2M is offered in the comment, since the cyber limit is the element we most need.

proposal.summary: Bring Contractor's insurance limits up to playbook levels: CGL 1M/2M aggregate, E&O 2M, add cyber liability 5M, and extend coverage one year post-term.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Contractor personnel may work at our facilities and access our systems and Confidential Information, so we have aligned the limits with our standard position: general liability of USD 1M per occurrence / 2M aggregate, E&O of USD 2M, and cyber liability of USD 5M, maintained through the term and for one year after. If USD 5M cyber is not available on Contractor's program, we can accept E&O of USD 1M and cyber of USD 2M as a fallback.

ops.oldText: Throughout the term of this Agreement, Contractor shall maintain workers compensation insurance in the amount required by statute, comprehensive general liability insurance with coverage of at least one million dollars ($1,000,000) and professional errors and omissions insurance for bodily injury, property damage or other losses with coverage of at least one million dollars ($1,000,000), in connection with the provision of Services by Contractor pursuant to the terms of this Agreement.
ops.newText: Throughout the term of this Agreement and for one (1) year thereafter, Contractor shall maintain, at its own expense, workers compensation insurance in the amount required by statute, comprehensive general liability insurance with coverage of at least one million dollars ($1,000,000) per occurrence and two million dollars ($2,000,000) in the aggregate, professional errors and omissions insurance for bodily injury, property damage or other losses with coverage of at least two million dollars ($2,000,000), and, where Contractor processes, stores or has access to Company data or Confidential Information, cyber liability insurance with coverage of at least five million dollars ($5,000,000), in connection with the provision of Services by Contractor pursuant to the terms of this Agreement.
